textPresets.name: Artemis 31B v1.2
textPresets.description: Made for roleplay and storytelling, by TheDrummer. Can look at pictures you paste.

rating.note: Richest scenes and best tension; other characters act on their own. Now and then slips on a sheet detail.

textPresets.name: Orion 26B-A4B v1.1
textPresets.description: Roleplay model by TheDrummer, built on a Gemma 4 mixture of experts: writes fast even with most of it in system memory, so it suits cards under 24 GB. Can look at pictures you paste.

rating.note: Close to Artemis and the fastest of all. Can misspell a name once in a while.

textPresets.name: For-Her-Darkside 26B-A4B v1.4
textPresets.description: Adult roleplay model by ReadyArt on the same fast Gemma 4 mixture of experts as Orion, trained on explicit roleplay. Its licence asks for personal, non-commercial use. Can look at pictures you paste.

rating.note: Stays in intimate scenes with dialogue where others fade out, and fast; a few stock words.

textPresets.name: MeroMero v2 31B
textPresets.description: Roleplay model by zerofata on Gemma 4, the same size as Artemis: its maker reports fewer clichés and more varied rerolls. Can look at pictures you paste.

rating.note: Clean prose with no clichés, but flatter than Artemis; once repeated your own line back.

textPresets.name: Glistening Gem 31B v2.1
textPresets.description: Prose-focused mix of Artemis, MeroMero and an uncensored Gemma 4, by sophosympatheia. Can glue or misspell a word now and then. Can look at pictures you paste.

rating.note: Follows your actions closely with good pacing; a few stock words.

textPresets.name: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored
textPresets.description: Uncensored Qwen 3.8 by HauhauCS: newer base and long memory, but not trained for roleplay, so its prose can be drier. Can look at pictures you paste.

rating.note: Short and tidy, keeps to the narration length best, but not tuned for roleplay (tested on another uncensored build of the same model).

textPresets.name: Wicked Tutu 31B
textPresets.description: Dark and explicit roleplay on Gemma 4, by ReadyArt. Its licence asks for personal, non-commercial use. New, not yet compared with Artemis. Cannot look at pictures.

textPresets.name: Rocinante-X 12B
textPresets.description: Small roleplay model by TheDrummer, for cards and computers with little memory. Cannot look at pictures.

rating.note: Can ignore what you just did and the narration length; fine when memory is short.

textPresets.name: Cydonia 24B v4.3
textPresets.description: Mid-size roleplay model by TheDrummer, for 16 to 24 GB cards. Cannot look at pictures.

rating.note: Shortest replies and the most stock phrases.

imagePresets.name: Z-Image Turbo (realistic)
imagePresets.description: Photographic and 3D-render pictures in 8 steps, from Alibaba (Apache licence). Follows plain sentences well. No portrait reference, so faces stay less steady than with the anime models.

imagePresets.name: Z-Image (realistic)
imagePresets.description: The full Z-Image model behind Turbo, from Alibaba (Apache licence): same size, but it heeds what a picture must not show ("no earrings") and varies more between pictures. About four times slower than Turbo. No portrait reference.

imagePresets.name: Flux.1 dev
imagePresets.description: Follows the scene closely and draws believable people and hands. The biggest download, and the story model gets a smaller build next to it.

imagePresets.name: Chroma1-HD
imagePresets.description: A Flux-class model retrained to be uncensored (Apache licence), with strong prompt adherence and a negative prompt that works. Slower than Flux; no portrait reference.

imagePresets.name: HiDream-I1 Full
imagePresets.description: The strictest prompt follower of the open models, and the slowest: 17B weights plus four text encoders. Takes most of the graphics card, so the story model runs partly in system memory. No portrait reference.

recommendations.why: Artemis at a good build next to Z-Image, which follows busy scenes closely and heeds what the lore says a picture must not show.
Z-Image follows scenes closely and heeds what the lore says a picture must not show; at 6 GB it leaves Artemis a sharper build than Chroma would.
Anime sprites with clear expressions in seconds, and the small picture model leaves Artemis a bigger build.
The whole card goes to the story: the sharpest Artemis build that fits and twice the story memory.

combos.why: A small story model and small picture models; they take turns on the card, so pictures come a little slower.
Orion keeps most of itself in your system memory and still writes faster than you read, and it can look at pictures you paste.
A 12B story model made for roleplay next to a small picture model.
Orion keeps most of itself in your system memory, so the card is free for pictures; it can look at pictures you paste.
Orion in your system memory leaves room on the card for NoobAI, the strongest anime model for sprites and expressions.
Rocinante at a sharp build and NoobAI both fit on the card.
Orion, partly in your system memory, writes fast and sees pictures; NoobAI or Z-Image draw in seconds.
Rocinante at its sharpest build next to the picture model, both whole on the card.
Orion, mostly on the card and a little in your system memory, writes fast and sees pictures you paste.
Artemis, the strongest story model here, at a 4-bit build next to a picture model that draws what the lore says.
